temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin admits he is unhappy, stuck, and unfulfilled in his construction job; he has thought about change but feels overwhelmed and unsure where to start; he agrees to explore options with Angela.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela had noticed Kevin seemed unhappy with his construction job and was concerned that he might be dissatisfied, though she did not yet know the details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her concern is confirmed, and she learns Kevin is open to discussing and exploring career alternatives.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is unhappy and unfulfilled in his current job and is willing to look into other career options with her support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and supportive, with some hope.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Kevin figure out what might make him happier and to look into possible job or career options together.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin thanks Angela for the job openings and career counseling information; he says he has been thinking a lot and is interested in something more creative, possibly design or architecture.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believed Kevin was considering a career change and felt supportive and hopeful about helping him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Kevin's interest in a creative field gives Angela a more specific direction for his possible career change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is considering a career change and is specifically interested in creative work such as design or architecture; the resources may help him explore this.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Kevin to check out the resources and continue exploring design or architecture as a possible path.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin says he appreciates Angela arranging the career-coach meeting but is not sure he is ready; he eventually agrees to give it a shot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believed Kevin was hesitant about making a career change and felt frustrated and worried, so she decided to motivate him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, but partly confirms and softens her belief: Kevin's hesitation is real, yet he is willing to meet the career coach when encouraged.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is hesitant but willing to take a step forward with the career coach; he may need support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Frustrated and worried, but also hopeful and resolute when he agrees.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To motivate Kevin through the career-coach meeting and support him every step of the way.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin reports that the career coach has been helpful, he has started online courses in design, and he feels more confident about the change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believed Kevin was making progress in his career transition and felt proud and relieved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her belief that Kevin is progressing is confirmed and strengthened by his concrete actions and growing confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is making real progress in his career transition, is taking design courses, and is gaining confidence.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in regularly and offering help whenever Kevin needs it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin accepts Angela's celebration party, expresses gratitude, and agrees to celebrate his new career success with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career and felt happy and satisfied.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change; the event affirms her belief that Kevin has succeeded and appreciates her support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin has successfully transitioned to a new career and deserves to celebrate; their supportive friendship remains strong.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To celebrate Kevin's success, enjoy the party with him, and continue being a supportive friend.
